mechanism_narrative: A sustained month-over-month increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates robust labor market conditions and rising corporate hiring, directly boosting earnings expectations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate (UNRATE) falling below 4.5% signals a tight labor market that accelerates consumer spending and corporate profit growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE falls below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate synchronized expansion in manufacturing and construction sectors, driving economic growth and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for the INDPRO-HOUST interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or positive returns occur in less than 45% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), CPIAUCSL exceeding 3.0% annually signals persistent inflation requiring further rate hikes, depressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising personal consumption expenditure (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, directly supporting corporate revenue growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where RSAFS increases by at least 0.3% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 100 (2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction, reducing economic growth momentum and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO falls below 100.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeding 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 2200 thousand units signals strong residential construction activity and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST exceeds 2200 thousand units.
